FLZ076>078-010900- /O.EXT.KKEY.CF.Y.0003.000000T0000Z-261001T0900Z/ Monroe Upper Keys-Monroe Middle Keys-Monroe Lower Keys- 1136 AM EDT Wed Sep 30 2026
...COASTAL FLOOD ADVISORY NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 5 AM EDT THURSDAY...
* WHAT...Saltwater flooding.
* WHERE...Florida Keys.
* WHEN...Until 5 AM EDT Thursday.
* IMPACTS...Saltwater flooding of low elevation streets and lots is expected. Some storm drains will overflow, and some seawalls and docks will be overtopped. Boaters can expect less clearance under fixed bridges. Motorists should remember that persistent puddles around the times of high tide are almost certain to contain a mix of saltwater.
PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property.
